rationale.he: דיירקט is Israeli usage for an Instagram DM ('שלח בדיירקט'); אנ- as in אנדרגראונד. Takes prefixes without a hyphen: לאנדיירקט.
rationale.hi: डायरेक्ट is the everyday Hindi loan (डायरेक्ट मैसेज, डायरेक्ट टैक्स); अन- as in अनइंस्टॉल, and Cutling's कटलिंग also writes English /ʌ/ as अ.

rationale.ja: ダイレクト is the settled katakana for 'direct' (Instagram's ダイレクトメッセージ); アン- as in アンインストール, アンフォロー. 7 kana, the length of Apple's own ショートカット label.
rationale.kn: ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟ್ is the Kannada loan (ಡೈರೆಕ್ಟರ್); ಅನ್ joined by a zero-width non-joiner as in ಆನ್‌ಲೈನ್, so ನ್ಡ does not fuse into a conjunct.
rationale.ko: 다이렉트 is the standard loan spelling (Instagram's 다이렉트 메시지, 외래어 표기법); 언- as in 언팔로우, 언인스톨.
rationale.ml: ഡയറക്ട് is the Malayalam loan (ഡയറക്ടർ); അൺ- with the chillu as in അൺലോക്ക്. Inflects: അൺഡയറക്ടിലേക്ക്.
rationale.mr: डायरेक्ट is the Marathi loan as in Hindi; अन- for un-, matching Cutling's कटलिंग. Postpositions attach: अनडायरेक्टमध्ये.

rationale.pa: ਡਾਇਰੈਕਟ is the Gurmukhi loan (ਡਾਇਰੈਕਟਰ); ਅਨ- for un-, as Cutling's ਕਟਲਿੰਗ writes /ʌ/.

rationale.ta: டைரக்ட் is the Tamil loan (டைரக்டர், film director); அன்- with visible pulli. Inflects: அன்டைரக்டுக்கு, அன்டைரக்டை.
rationale.te: డైరెక్ట్ is the Telugu loan (డైరెక్టర్, film director); అన్ joined by a zero-width non-joiner as in ఆన్‌లైన్.
rationale.th: ไดเรกต์ in Royal Institute style, the style Thai software uses for ไดเรกทอรี and Cutling follows in คัตลิง; อัน- as in อันฟอลโลว์. Set off by spaces inside sentences because อัน is also an everyday word.

rationale.uk: директ is the Ukrainian loan too (Instagram DMs); same Cyrillic as Russian, declines: в Андиректі.
rationale.ur: ڈائریکٹ is the Urdu loan (ڈائریکٹر); zabar on the alef (اَن) because unmarked ان also reads 'in', which would make the name 'Indirect'.

_note: Both code styles: App Store / .lproj codes (hyphen) and Extension/_locales folders (underscore). The drafts' ext.meta.name is the source merge.py reads; this file records the spellings and why. 'Undirect' is an old English adjective meaning 'indirect' (Webster 1913, Wiktionary). The App Store listing name stays Latin in every locale.
